ruleDefinitions.name: Exports Critical Registry Keys To a File
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the export of a crital Registry key to a file.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\regedit\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "REGEDIT\.EXE") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-E\\ .*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*hklm.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*hkey\\_local\\_machine.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX("\\\\system$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\\sam$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\\security$")))
